Who We Are
SunPork Group is dedicated to delivering the finest quality fresh Australian pork to market. We are proud to be the
largest Australian farmer owned and operated producer of quality Australian pork products. Employing 1,500+
employees across 52 locations in Australia and NZ.

SunPork is committed to animal welfare and the responsible, ethical care of animals to ensure their comfort, health
and welfare. Together with our dedicated specialist veterinary health, nutrition, research and development teams, and
farm and production teams, the person in this position is committed to the care of our pigs and the production of high
quality, sustainable pork.

What We Offer

By joining us, you will become part of an ever-growing family–passionate about producing the best quality Aussie
pork for Aussie plates. At SunPork we provide:

Professional learning and development opportunities;
Competitive salary;
Enjoy staff discounts on a range of products;
Base salary range: $79,500-$80,500.00 + Superannuation

The Opportunity

Sunpork Consolidated Pty Ltd requires Agricultural Engineering Technologist (Feedmill) to directly support our
Queensland Feedmill operations. The position is full time and will be based out of our Feedmill in Warra, Queensland.
This position requires ongoing testing and implementation of Feedmill engineering and production technologies to
support smooth and efficient production at all times.

Responsibilities, tasks, and duties:
-Operate, monitor and maintain feed mill production equipment and automated systems to support safe, efficient and
reliable feed manufacturing.
-Analyse production processes, equipment performance and operational data to identify opportunities for continuous
improvement and increased efficiency.
-Troubleshoot mechanical, process and automation issues, carrying out running repairs and supporting preventative
maintenance activities to minimise downtime.
-Support the implementation, optimisation and ongoing development of feed mill technologies, automation systems
and engineering solutions.
-Monitor raw material inventory, stock control systems, weighbridge operations and production reporting to ensure
accuracy and operational effectiveness.
-Conduct quality checks, process testing and equipment calibration activities to ensure compliance with FeedSafe
GMP standards and company quality requirements.
-Maintain a strong focus on workplace health and safety, quality assurance and environmental compliance while
promoting best-practice standards across the Feed Mill.
-Collaborate with operations, maintenance and management teams to support production targets, solve technical
challenges and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications and experience

-At least a Bachelor's Degree level qualification
-Minimum 12 months relevant work experience
- Preparedness to work flexible hours (including some weekends and public holidays)
-Have the ability to work under pressure to meet production and customer requirements
-Be committed to upholding the highest levels of animal welfare and bio-security standards
-Be willing to undertake any additional training required for the role
-A demonstrated professional, safe organised and disciplined approach to work
-Current drivers licence

Work Location: In person

SunPork is an equal opportunity employer.

At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers.
A fantastic opportunity to be part of a team that focuses on cutting-edge technology and quality engineering principles.
Full-time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide. 


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help us ensure consumer needs are met by embedding robust testing strategies and automation practices that uphold software reliability, performance, and security. Deliver seamless, high-quality digital experiences that build customer trust and satisfaction.



As a Senior Quality Engineer – Conversational AI, you’ll be responsible for testing and validating chatbot solutions while helping shape and evolve our CAI quality engineering capability. You’ll work closely with product, engineering and AI teams to design automated chatbot tests, validate conversation flows, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. With the freedom to identify and implement the best solutions, you’ll continuously improve our tools, frameworks and overall approach to CAI testing.



You’ll Have

Strong experience in Quality Engineering or QA, with hands-on experience testing Conversational AI or chatbot platforms
Proven experience using Cyara Botium for chatbot test automation
Expertise in testing conversation flows, intents, entities and dialogue management across multiple scenarios
Experience validating chatbot integrations with backend systems and APIs
Ability to design and execute end-to-end test strategies for AI-driven customer experiences
Experience embedding chatbot testing into CI/CD pipelines
Strong understanding of the challenges of testing AI systems, including ambiguity, edge cases and training data validation
Experience testing non-functional requirements such as performance, security and accessibility in conversational interfaces
Confidence collaborating with cross-functional teams to embed quality early in the delivery lifecycle
Strong analytical skills to interpret chatbot behaviour and translate insights into quality improvements
Excellent communication, documentation and stakeholder engagement skills
Experience working with Mobile apps as the entry point to the chat bot.
A continuous improvement mindset and passion for emerging AI technologies
Confidence contributing to go/no-go decisions for chatbot and CAI releases


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger. 

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers. 

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless. 


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.  

We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan. 

Apply at the earliest to be considered!

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

result.description:
Valley Park Farm is a locally owned Victorian business. Our first farm was established in the heart of one of Australia’s most productive farming lands, the Goulburn Valley. Our three original sites are bordered by the Goulburn River on one side and Great Dividing Range on the other.

Expansion in 2012 saw the addition of a farm nestled amongst the rolling hills of the Strathbogie Ranges. An abundant fresh water natural spring carries life and nourishment to our free-range hens, where our farm began free range egg production in 2013.

We are seeking highly skilled and highly efficient Maintenance Engineer to join our team of professionals on a full-time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Work to verbal and/or written instructions provided by General Manager and Technical Manager
Ensure the efficient functioning of the Sanovo Grader Pro
Recommend and develop maintenance procedures, in accordance with operational requirements and technical specifications.
Regular scheduled maintenance programs to cover a wide range of Sanovo equipment, including all other equipment and building used in grading operation
Actively engage with training of nominated VPF maintenance staff to satisfy a high level of knowledge and capability with reference to operating and maintaining the Sanovo Grader pro and associated ancillary equipment.
Analyse operational/technical problems. Determine and report on appropriate courses of action
Ensures the implementation of Valley Park Farm Quality Policy and quality system.
Respond to and resolve emergency breakdown and repair requirements.
Perform preventative, general and emergency maintenance requirements.
Maintain inventory of supplies, tools, equipment or material to ensure that sufficient resources are available, and items are in usable condition
Report workplace hazards identified during the course of work to appropriate person according to standard operating procedures.
Ensures the safe disposal of waste materials in compliance with regulations
Ensures strict compliance with the principles of quarantine, and bio security in all Valley Park Farm operations.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Strong mechanical knowledge on a wide variety of equipment
Mechanical Maintenance Engineer trade qualification or equivalent
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Strong diagnostic abilities
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Honest, diligent and able to perform assigned duties to the best of your knowledge and abilities
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary from $95,000 per annum (incl Accommodation and Utility) + Super
